quote: Many of our aerospace bearing products are designed and certified during the original development of the aircraft being served, which often makes us the primary bearing supplier for the life of the aircraft.
why: "certified"と"for the life of the aircraft"で機体への組込を名指すが、顧客側の再認定は断定せず

quote: The initial term of these contracts ranges from one to seven years, with a typical duration of five years.
why: 保守契約の"initial term"が"one to seven years"（典型"five years"）で複数年の購買義務を名指す。再認定の記述はない

quote: In many instances, we provide our services pursuant to agreements that are subject to periodic competitive reprocurements.
why: 契約は"periodic competitive reprocurements"にかかり随意解約も可で、顧客が乗り換え費用を負う機構がない

quote: For some products, our unique manufacturing capabilities are required by the customer's specifications or designs, thereby necessitating reliance on us for the production of such specially designed products.
why: "customer's specifications"への組込で"necessitating reliance on us"だが、再認定は断定せず

quote: Client contracts for investment processing solutions offered through TRUST 3000® have initial terms that are generally three to seven years in length.
why: 処理委託の契約が"initial terms"で"three to seven years"と複数年の購買義務を名指す。再認定の記述はない

quote: The term of these contracts varies between facilities, but they typically can be terminated with cause for various reasons and usually contain provisions allowing for termination without cause by either party upon 90 days notice.
why: 病院との契約は"termination without cause"を"90 days notice"で認め、顧客の乗り換え費用の機構がない

quote: Our equipment and software are highly sophisticated and require a high level of training and education to use them competently and safely—requirements made even more important because they work together within integrated environments.
why: "training and education"と"integrated environments"で再教育を名指すが、開放方針で固着は弱い

quote: The companion animal healthcare industry is highly competitive with few barriers to entry.
why: "highly competitive with few barriers to entry"という一般的な競争記述のみで、乗り換え費用の機構がない

quote: Competition in the athletic apparel industry is principally on the basis of brand image and recognition as well as product quality, innovation, style, distribution and price.
why: 競争は"brand image"や"price"で決まるという一般記述のみ。顧客の乗り換え費用を示す機構はない

quote: The Company believes that if AT&T terminated its relationship with the Company, AT&T would encounter substantial costs in replacing the Company' transaction management solutions.
why: 顧客が"substantial costs in replacing"を負うと述べるが"believes"の見解で再認定の断定ではない→70

quote: Open-end fund investors may redeem their investments in those funds at any time without prior notice.
why: 投資家は"at any time without prior notice"で"redeem"でき、顧客が乗り換え費用を負う機構がない

quote: The principal areas of competition are brand recognition, taste, quality, price, advertising, promotion, convenience and service.
why: 競争は"brand recognition"や"price"等によるという一般記述のみで、乗り換え費用の機構がない
